name: Foreseerr
overview: Requests, discovery, and a release calendar inside Jellyfin, signed in with your Jellyfin account.
description: Alpha, in active development: anything can change, and there is no backward compatibility between plugin versions. Runs Foreseerr as a background process inside Jellyfin and opens it at /Foreseerr with the user's Jellyfin sign-in. Connection settings, libraries, and the first administrator come from this server. Linux x64/arm64 and Windows x64 only. Third-party repository; not in the official catalog.
